title: Athena, 2 dollars

specs.Decoration: microprinting, selective antique finish, resin fill

descriptionPlain: Description Symbol of courage, justice, and inner strength Greek goddess in a contemporary interpretation Helmet and shield details rendered in precise relief Athena embodies both wisdom and warrior-like determination. A timeless symbol of bravery, strategy, and inner balance, she is portrayed with exceptional precision — every detail of her helmet and shield stands out in masterfully sculpted relief. Elements of Greek mythology are reimagined with a modern touch, resulting in a collectible piece of striking character.
